verdict.rationale: The evidence presents Kong as an API/AI/MCP gateway and management platform. Storing request 'collections' as plain-text files in a repo is an API-client workspace capability, outside a gateway's product category. decK and declarative DB-less configuration handle gateway configuration-as-code, which is a different capability and does not transfer to this collections story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can store collections as plain text files in my repo and version them with git
